answer: Upstream-Diversity Decay weights each agent's capacity by the entropy of its three-hop ancestor terrace; clones in one parent cluster see per-node weight shrink as 1/N. A juniper-floor rule zeroes nodes below minimum entropy, forcing attackers to diversify upstream links rather than replicate. Each fake identity costs a paid fable-route: a distinct three-hop path bought per clone, making marginal cost grow linearly.
